GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 676.3 (3 Nov 47) CCS
(SCAPIN - 1811/2)
APO 500
1 June 1949
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Operation of Great Northern Telegraph Company Cable Station and Facilities at Nagasaki.
1. Reference is made to:
a. Memorandum for Japanese Government, file AG 676.3 (3 Nov 47)CCS, SCAPN 1811, dated 3 November 1947 as amended, subject as above.
b. Memorandum from Japanese Government, Central Liaison and Coordination Office, file CLCO No. 1357(2P), dated 19 May 1949, subject: Prolongation of Agreement Between Ministry of Communications and Great Northern Telegraph Company.
2. Pursuant to letters dated 14 May 1949, exchanged between the Ministry of Communications and the Great Northern Telegraph Company, Limited, extension of the agreement dated 12 October 1948 as amended, between the Ministry of Communications and the Great Northern Telegraph Company, Limited, is approved.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
